faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our resume builder
faq.q1: Is Resumer really free to use?
faq.a1: Yes, you can create and edit your resume for free. We offer a free plan with access to basic templates and features. Premium templates and advanced features are available with our paid plans.
faq.a2: An ATS-friendly resume uses standard formatting, clear section headings, and common fonts that Applicant Tracking Systems can easily parse. All our templates are designed with ATS compatibility in mind.
faq.q3: Can I download my resume as a PDF?
faq.a3: Absolutely! You can download your resume in PDF, Word (DOCX), or PNG format. PDF is recommended for most job applications as it preserves your formatting across all devices.
faq.q4: How do I choose the right template?
faq.a4: Consider your industry and career level. Professional templates work well for corporate roles, modern templates suit tech and startups, and creative templates are great for design and marketing positions.
faq.a5: Yes! You can create as many resumes as you need. We recommend tailoring your resume for each job application to increase your chances of landing an interview.
faq.q6: Is my data safe and private?
faq.a6: Absolutely. We use industry-standard encryption to protect your data. Your personal information is never shared with third parties. You can delete your account and all associated data at any time.
faq.q7: Can I create a resume in another language?
faq.a7: Yes, Resumer supports multiple languages. You can create resumes in English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, and many more languages.
faq.q8: Do I need to create an account?
faq.a8: You can start building your resume without an account. However, creating a free account lets you save your progress, access your resumes from any device, and manage multiple documents.
faq.q9: Can I also create a cover letter?
faq.a9: Yes! Our platform includes a cover letter builder with matching templates. A well-crafted cover letter paired with your resume significantly increases your chances of getting an interview.
faq.q10: How do I cancel my subscription?
faq.a10: You can cancel your subscription at any time from your account settings. There are no cancellation fees, and you will continue to have access to premium features until the end of your billing period.
faq.q11: What if I need help with my resume content?
faq.a11: Our builder includes expert tips and suggestions for every section. We also provide pre-written examples and phrases tailored to various industries and roles to help you write compelling content.
